meta.persona: Ana Ferreira is a 34-year-old senior UX designer at a fintech startup in Lisbon, married to Miguel with a 5-year-old daughter Beatriz and a dog named Sushi. She is learning Japanese, training for a half marathon, renovating her apartment, and planning a family trip to Japan in November 2026.

en.description: The user's job title and employer.
en.content: The user is a senior UX designer at Ledgerly, a Lisbon-based fintech startup focused on personal budgeting tools.

en.description: The user's immediate family members and dog.
en.content: The user is married to Miguel and has a 5-year-old daughter named Beatriz. They also have a rescue dog named Sushi. Beatriz's school runs from 9:00 to 15:30 on weekdays.

en.description: The user has celiac disease.
en.content: The user has celiac disease and must strictly avoid gluten. Cross-contamination is a serious concern for her.

en.description: The user is learning Japanese at an intermediate level.
en.content: The user is learning Japanese and is currently around JLPT N4 level. She uses WaniKani for kanji and has weekly italki tutoring sessions.

en.description: The user's favorite weekend walk in Lisbon.
en.content: The user lives in the Graça neighborhood of Lisbon and often walks her dog Sushi to the Miradouro da Senhora do Monte viewpoint on weekend mornings.

en.description: The user's husband's job and work setup.
en.content: The user's husband Miguel is a data engineer at OutSystems and works a hybrid schedule with two days in the office.

en.description: The user has mild exercise-induced asthma.
en.content: The user has mild exercise-induced asthma and uses a blue salbutamol inhaler 15 minutes before running. She carries the inhaler during all workouts.

en.description: The user holds employee stock options and saves a fixed salary percentage.
en.content: The user holds employee stock options at Ledgerly and automatically saves 20% of her monthly salary into a separate savings account.

en.description: The user is leading a mobile app redesign with a strict deadline.
en.content: The user is leading the redesign of the Ledgerly mobile app, with a deadline at the end of Q3. User testing sessions are scheduled for the second week of September.

en.description: The user is preparing for the JLPT N4 exam in December.
en.content: The user is preparing for the Japanese Language Proficiency Test N4 in December. She does 30 minutes of Anki vocabulary review every evening before bed.

en.description: The user is training for the Lisbon Half Marathon.
en.content: The user is training for the Lisbon Half Marathon in October. Her plan includes four runs per week, with long runs on Saturday mornings.

en.description: The user is renovating her apartment kitchen and bathroom.
en.content: The user is renovating the kitchen and bathroom of her Graça apartment. The total budget is €30,000, and the contractor is scheduled to start work on September 1.

en.description: The user has a fixed-price freelance website project for a local bakery.
en.content: The user is doing a freelance project for a local gluten-free bakery, designing a simple website for a fixed price of €1,500.

en.description: The user is doing weekly watercolor painting with her daughter.
en.content: The user is learning watercolor painting alongside her daughter Beatriz. They aim to complete one small painting together every Sunday afternoon.

en.description: The user is building a personal sleep tracking dashboard.
en.content: The user is building a personal sleep tracking dashboard using Python and the Fitbit API. She wants to identify correlations between late screen time and poor sleep quality.

en.description: The user is trying a weekly gluten-free Japanese recipe.
en.content: The user is trying to cook one new gluten-free Japanese recipe each week with her family. Recent successes include tamagoyaki and chicken teriyaki with tamari.

en.description: The user has booked a family trip to Japan for November.
en.content: The user booked a family trip to Japan from November 8 to 22, 2026. Flights are TAP Lisbon to Tokyo, and the family will spend five nights in Kyoto before returning to Tokyo.

en.description: The user is running the Lisbon Half Marathon on October 5.
en.content: The user is registered for the Lisbon Half Marathon on October 5, 2025. Her goal is to finish under 2 hours and 15 minutes.

en.description: The user is presenting at a UX conference in Barcelona.
en.content: The user is presenting a case study at a UX conference in Barcelona from September 18 to 20. Her talk is on designing accessible fintech interfaces.

en.description: The user's daughter has a school play on June 14.
en.content: Beatriz has a school play on June 14 at 18:00. The user and Miguel plan to attend together, and Beatriz has a small speaking role.

en.description: The user took a past trip to Porto with Miguel in March 2025.
en.content: The user and Miguel visited Porto in March 2025 for a weekend. They stayed in the Ribeira district and especially enjoyed a port wine tasting at a small cellar in Vila Nova de Gaia.

en.description: The user has an annual physical scheduled with Dr. Costa.
en.content: The user has an annual physical appointment with Dr. Costa on July 3 at 9:30. She needs to bring her latest blood test results.

en.description: The user attends a weekly Japanese conversation meetup.
en.content: The user attends a Japanese conversation meetup every Thursday evening at a language cafe in downtown Lisbon. She started attending in February 2026.

en.description: The user has a birthday dinner for her mother on June 28.
en.content: The user is organizing a birthday dinner for her mother on June 28 at 19:30. The chosen restaurant is a vegan place her mother requested, and the user must verify gluten-free options in advance.

en.description: The user prefers gluten-free restaurants and asks about cross-contamination.
en.content: The user prefers restaurants with clearly labeled gluten-free menus and always asks staff about cross-contamination practices before ordering.

en.description: The user dislikes cilantro and finds it soapy.
en.content: The user strongly dislikes cilantro and says it tastes soapy to her. She asks for it to be omitted from dishes whenever possible.

en.description: The user prefers Figma for UI design work.
en.content: The user prefers Figma over Sketch or Adobe XD for UI design. She relies heavily on auto-layout and shared component libraries.

en.description: The user wants work-related responses to be concise and bullet-pointed.
en.content: The user wants work-related answers to be concise and formatted as bullet points. The assistant should avoid emojis in professional contexts and include next steps or action items when relevant.

en.description: The user likes literary fiction recommendations in Portuguese or English.
en.content: The user enjoys literary fiction and prefers book recommendations in Portuguese or English. She recently liked 'The Memory Police' by Yoko Ogawa.

en.description: The user prefers an aisle seat and gluten-free meals on flights.
en.content: The user prefers an aisle seat on flights and always pre-orders a gluten-free meal. She avoids booking flights with very short layovers.

en.description: The user uses dark mode and night shift after 9pm.
en.content: The user enables dark mode on all devices and uses night shift settings after 21:00 to reduce eye strain. She also uses a blue light filter on her work MacBook.

en.description: The user listens to podcasts while running.
en.content: The user listens to podcasts while running, especially true crime and design-related shows. Her current favorites are 'Criminal' and '99% Invisible'.

en.description: The assistant must never suggest gluten-containing foods or restaurants.
en.content: The user has celiac disease, so the assistant must never suggest recipes or restaurants containing gluten and must always offer gluten-free alternatives when food is discussed.

en.description: The assistant should draft formal Portuguese messages to Beatriz's school.
en.content: When drafting messages to Beatriz's school, the assistant should use formal Portuguese with 'você' and keep the message under 150 words.

en.description: The assistant should include offline functionality and Portuguese support when comparing software.
en.content: When comparing software or apps, the assistant should always include whether the product works offline and whether it supports Portuguese.

en.description: The assistant must remind the user about her inhaler if she mentions breathing difficulty after exercise.
en.content: If the user mentions breathing difficulty, wheezing, or chest tightness during or after exercise, the assistant must remind her to stop the activity and use her blue salbutamol inhaler immediately.

en.description: The user's previous employer and role.
en.content: The user previously worked as a UX designer at PixelCraft, a digital product agency in Porto, for three years. She focused on healthcare and e-commerce clients before joining FinLumina.

en.description: The user's education and degree.
en.content: The user holds a Bachelor's degree in Communication Design from the University of Lisbon, graduating in 2012. She remains in contact with her design school mentor, Professor Almeida.

en.description: The user's preferred tool for user flow diagrams.
en.content: The user prefers to use Miro for creating user flow diagrams and journey maps during the discovery phase of projects. She finds it more collaborative than sketching on paper.

en.description: The user's preferred prototyping tool beyond Figma.
en.content: For high-fidelity interactive prototypes, the user prefers ProtoPie over Figma's built-in prototyping because it allows more advanced micro-interactions and conditional logic.

en.description: The user's current direct report.
en.content: The user currently manages one junior UX designer, Carolina, and is mentoring her on design systems and stakeholder communication.

en.description: The user's current app redesign project deadline.
en.content: The user is leading the redesign of FinLumina's consumer banking app, internally named 'Projeto Aurora'. The deadline for the first release is March 31, 2026, and it includes a completely new onboarding flow and dashboard.

en.description: The user's freelance bakery website project details.
en.content: The user's freelance project for a local bakery called 'Padaria da Esquina' involves building a WordPress site with an online ordering system. She is using Figma for the design and collaborating with a freelance developer, Marcos, and the site must launch by August 15.

en.description: The user's preferred communication channel at work.
en.content: The user prefers using Slack for quick questions and async updates, but uses email only for formal communication with external partners or HR. She dislikes unscheduled video calls.

en.description: The user's typical work schedule.
en.content: The user typically works a hybrid schedule: in the office on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, and remotely on Mondays and Fridays. She starts her workday at 9:00 AM and finishes around 6:00 PM, with a lunch break at 1:00 PM.

en.description: How to format meeting notes for the user.
en.content: The assistant should format meeting notes with a summary of decisions, a list of action items with owners and due dates, and any blockers. The user wants this in bullet points, not prose.

en.description: The user's preferred tool for developer handoff.
en.content: The user prefers using Zeplin for developer handoff of final designs, even though Figma has built-in specs, because her engineering team is used to Zeplin's annotation features.

en.description: The user's reporting line and key colleagues.
en.content: The user reports directly to the VP of Product, Sofia Martins, and works closely with the Product Manager, João Silva, on prioritization.

en.description: The user is building a design system.
en.content: The user is currently building a design system for FinLumina to unify UI components across the web and mobile apps. It's called 'Sistema Lume' and she is using Figma's library and Tokens Studio for design tokens.

en.description: The user's approach to design critiques.
en.content: The user prefers design critiques to focus on specific user flows rather than general aesthetics. She asks for feedback in the form of 'What would you change and why?' rather than open-ended opinions.

en.description: The user's upcoming presentation at a UX conference.
en.content: The user is scheduled to give a talk titled 'Designing for Trust in Fintech' at UX Spain in Barcelona on June 5, 2026. She needs to prepare slides by May 20.

en.description: The user's project management tool preference for freelance vs. work.
en.content: The user uses Jira for her full-time job's project tracking but prefers Trello for her freelance bakery website project because it's simpler and client-facing.

en.description: How the user tracks her stock options and savings.
en.content: The user reviews her stock option vesting schedule and investment accounts on the first Sunday of each month. She uses a spreadsheet to track projected vesting value and adjusts her savings rate if needed.

en.description: The user's previous freelance project before the bakery.
en.content: Before the bakery website, the user freelanced for a local yoga studio, designing a simple booking site in 2024. That project helped her decide to take on more freelance work.

en.description: The user's approach to user research tools.
en.content: The user prefers using Maze for unmoderated usability testing because it integrates directly with her Figma prototypes. She runs tests with at least 5 users per flow before finalizing designs.

en.description: The user's previous employer in banking.
en.content: Before the agency, the user worked for two years as a UX designer at Millennium BCP, a large Portuguese bank, where she learned about financial regulations and design constraints in banking.

en.description: The user's view on remote work and meeting times.
en.content: The user values remote work and finds she is most productive in the morning at home. She prefers not to have meetings before 10:00 AM to preserve deep work time.

en.description: The user's app redesign performance goal.
en.content: The user's redesign project has a measurable goal: reduce app onboarding drop-off by 20% and increase first-week retention by 10% within three months of launch. She is tracking progress weekly with the data team.

en.description: The user's ongoing professional development.
en.content: The user is taking an online course on Design Leadership from the Interaction Design Foundation to prepare for a possible team lead role. She studies on weekday evenings after Beatriz goes to bed.

en.description: The user's accessibility standards for design.
en.content: The user uses Stark plugin in Figma to check contrast ratios and simulate color blindness when designing interfaces, and insists on WCAG AA compliance for all shipped features.

en.description: The user's past design sprint workshop.
en.content: In March 2026, the user facilitated a 5-day design sprint to define the onboarding flow for the app redesign. The outcome was a paper prototype that was later tested with 8 users.

en.description: How the assistant should handle requests for design feedback.
en.content: When the user asks for feedback on a design idea, the assistant should first ask clarifying questions about the target user and context, then provide actionable suggestions referencing design principles, not just aesthetic opinions.

en.description: The user's daily standup meeting time.
en.content: The user participates in a daily standup at 9:30 AM Lisbon time via Google Meet, where she gives updates on her design tasks and blockers. She prefers to keep her update under 2 minutes.

en.description: The user's theme preference for work design tools.
en.content: The user keeps dark mode enabled all day in Figma and other design tools because she finds light themes too glaring in her office's bright lighting.

en.description: The user's desk setup at work.
en.content: The user has a sit-stand desk at the FinLumina office and uses a 27-inch 4K monitor with her MacBook Pro. She prefers Logitech MX Master 3 mouse for ergonomic comfort during long design sessions.

en.description: The user's approach to version control for design files.
en.content: The user prefers to use Figma's branching feature for major redesigns, merging branches after design reviews. She avoids using multiple files for the same project to prevent confusion.

en.description: The user's upcoming design review meeting.
en.content: The user has a design review with the engineering lead, Rita, on April 20, 2026, to finalize the component library for the app redesign. She needs to prepare a checklist of all reusable components.

en.description: The user's tone for written communication at work.
en.content: The user prefers a direct and concise tone in work emails and messages, avoiding excessive pleasantries. She often uses bullet points and bolds key action items.

en.description: The user's career aspiration.
en.content: The user aspires to become a design manager within the next two years and is actively seeking opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives beyond the app redesign.

en.description: The user dislikes mushrooms due to their texture.
en.content: The user finds the texture of mushrooms unpleasant and always asks for them to be omitted when ordering dishes in restaurants. She also avoids buying them for home cooking.

en.description: The user loves sushi and sashimi and always carries her own gluten-free soy sauce.
en.content: The user enjoys sushi and sashimi because they are naturally gluten-free, but she always brings her own bottle of gluten-free tamari to restaurants to avoid wheat-based soy sauce. She has a small travel-sized container of it in her purse.

en.description: The user's favorite comfort food is gluten-free caldo verde.
en.content: The user's favorite comfort food is caldo verde, a Portuguese kale and potato soup. She makes it at home using a certified gluten-free chouriço and cornbread on the side.

en.description: The user maintains a small balcony herb garden.
en.content: The user has a small balcony herb garden where she grows basil, parsley, and mint. She uses these fresh herbs in her cooking, especially in salads and Portuguese dishes.

en.description: The user prefers strong black coffee in the morning.
en.content: The user starts her day with a strong black coffee without sugar. She buys whole beans from a local Lisbon roaster and grinds them fresh each morning.

en.description: The user enjoys a glass of vinho verde on warm evenings.
en.content: The user likes to relax with a glass of dry vinho verde, a young Portuguese wine, on warm evenings. She prefers it lightly chilled and often pairs it with grilled fish or salads.

en.description: The user avoids regular beer but enjoys a specific gluten-free brand.
en.content: Due to her celiac disease, the user avoids all beers that are not certified gluten-free. She has tried several brands and prefers 'Cerveja Sem Glúten' from a Portuguese microbrewery, which she buys for special occasions.

en.description: The user prefers mild to medium spice levels.
en.content: The user is not fond of overly spicy food and prefers mild to medium heat. When ordering, she asks for spicy sauces on the side so she can control the amount.

en.description: The user keeps a gluten-free snack in her desk at work.
en.content: The user keeps rice cakes with almond butter and sliced banana as a go-to snack at her office desk. She also has a stash of gluten-free granola bars for busy afternoons.

en.description: The user is working on perfecting a gluten-free sourdough starter.
en.content: The user is currently experimenting with a gluten-free sourdough starter, trying different flour blends like brown rice and sorghum. She bakes a small loaf every weekend and adjusts the hydration and fermentation times based on the results.

en.description: The user meal preps every Sunday for the work week.
en.content: The user dedicates Sunday afternoons to meal prepping for her work week. She cooks a large batch of quinoa, roasts a tray of mixed vegetables, and grills chicken breasts to portion into containers for lunches.

en.description: The user owns an air fryer and uses it frequently.
en.content: The user has an air fryer in her kitchen, which she uses for quick gluten-free meals like chicken wings, roasted potatoes, and vegetable chips. She finds it faster and easier to clean than a traditional oven.

en.description: The user and her daughter make gluten-free pancakes every Saturday.
en.content: Every Saturday morning, the user and her daughter Beatriz make gluten-free pancakes together using a specific flour blend of rice and tapioca. They top them with fresh fruit and a drizzle of honey.

en.description: The user listens to food podcasts while cooking dinner.
en.content: While preparing dinner, the user listens to food podcasts, often episodes about gluten-free baking or Portuguese cuisine. This is separate from the running podcasts she listens to during workouts.

en.description: The user subscribes to a weekly organic vegetable box delivery.
en.content: The user has a subscription to a weekly organic vegetable box from a local farm, delivered to her apartment every Tuesday. She plans her meals around the contents and often shares surplus vegetables with neighbors.

en.description: The user uses a slow cooker for winter stews.
en.content: During the colder months, the user uses a slow cooker to make large batches of gluten-free stews and soups, such as beef and vegetable stew or lentil soup. She freezes portions for busy weeknights.

en.description: The user's favorite gluten-free restaurant in Lisbon is a small bistro in Alfama.
en.content: The user's favorite gluten-free restaurant is a small bistro in the Alfama district of Lisbon called 'Tasca Sem Glúten'. She always orders the grilled sea bass with sautéed greens and trusts their dedicated gluten-free fryer for the potato side.

en.description: The user checks restaurant menus online and calls ahead about gluten-free options.
en.content: Before dining out, the user always checks the restaurant's menu online for gluten-free labels and then calls ahead to ask about cross-contamination practices, such as separate fryers and prep areas. She keeps a note in her phone with questions to ask.

en.description: The user attended a gluten-free cooking class in May 2025.
en.content: In May 2025, the user attended a gluten-free cooking class at 'Cozinha Sem Glúten' in Lisbon, where she learned to make fresh gluten-free pasta from scratch and a basil pesto. She uses the techniques from that class regularly in her home cooking.

en.description: The user avoids Chinese restaurants unless they advertise gluten-free options.
en.content: The user tends to avoid Chinese restaurants because of the risk of wheat-based soy sauce in most dishes. She will only visit those that explicitly advertise a gluten-free menu and have staff trained in allergen handling.

en.description: The user knows which stalls at Time Out Market have gluten-free options.
en.content: At the Time Out Market in Lisbon, the user has a mental list of stalls that offer gluten-free dishes, such as the sushi stall and a grilled fish counter. She avoids the fried food stalls because of shared fryers.

en.description: The user trusts a specific pizzeria for gluten-free pizza.
en.content: The user's go-to pizza place is 'Pizzaria Sem Glúten' which offers a certified gluten-free crust and uses a separate oven to avoid cross-contamination. She orders the margherita with extra fresh basil.

en.description: The user starts her day with warm lemon water.
en.content: The user begins each morning with a glass of warm water with freshly squeezed lemon juice, which she drinks before her coffee. She believes it aids digestion.

en.description: The user drinks a green smoothie for breakfast three times a week.
en.content: Three times a week, the user makes a green smoothie for breakfast using spinach, banana, pineapple, and a scoop of gluten-free protein powder. She also adds a tablespoon of flaxseed for extra fiber.

en.description: The user prefers sparkling water with lime when dining out.
en.content: When dining out, the user prefers to order sparkling water with a slice of lime instead of soda, as she wants to avoid any hidden gluten in fountain drinks and prefers a lighter option.

en.description: The user buys a specific gluten-free beer for special occasions.
en.content: For special occasions at home, the user buys a bottle of her favorite gluten-free beer, 'Cerveja Sem Glúten', which she drinks from her own glass to ensure no cross-contamination from shared glassware.

en.description: The user has an anniversary dinner reservation at 'Tasca Sem Glúten' on July 10.
en.content: The user has booked a table for two at 'Tasca Sem Glúten' for her wedding anniversary dinner on July 10. She has already requested the gluten-free dessert option and confirmed the restaurant's cross-contamination protocols.

en.description: The user does most grocery shopping at Continente and checks labels for gluten.
en.content: The user does her main grocery shopping at the local Continente supermarket, using their loyalty card for discounts. She carefully reads every label for gluten-containing ingredients and often spends extra time in the health food aisle.

en.description: The user orders gluten-free specialty products online.
en.content: The user regularly orders specialty gluten-free products from an online Portuguese store called 'Mercado Sem Glúten', including bread, pasta, and soy sauce. She keeps a cart saved with her regular items to reorder quickly.

en.description: The user avoids hidden gluten in sauces and processed foods.
en.content: The user is vigilant about reading ingredient lists for hidden gluten, particularly in sauces, seasonings, and processed meats. She avoids any product containing malt, modified food starch, or hydrolyzed wheat protein unless it is explicitly certified gluten-free.

en.description: The user plans weekly meals on a whiteboard and shops with a list.
en.content: The user plans her weekly meals on a whiteboard in the kitchen and creates a corresponding shopping list to avoid impulse purchases. This helps her stick to her grocery budget and reduces food waste.

en.description: The user shops at the farmers market with her daughter on Saturdays.
en.content: On Saturday mornings, the user takes her daughter Beatriz to the local farmers market to buy organic vegetables and fruit. They enjoy picking out seasonal produce together and often stop for a gluten-free pastry from a nearby bakery.

en.description: The assistant should format recipes with metric units and gluten-free substitutions.
en.content: When the assistant provides recipes, it should use metric measurements (grams, milliliters), include ingredient substitutions to make the dish gluten-free, and add warnings about potential cross-contamination during preparation. The assistant should also avoid suggesting any ingredient that contains gluten.

en.description: The user prefers running in the early morning.
en.content: The user prefers to run early in the morning around 6:30 AM to avoid Lisbon heat and to have family time in the evening. She finds morning runs also improve her sleep quality.

en.description: The user's resting heart rate is 58 bpm.
en.content: The user has a resting heart rate of 58 beats per minute, as measured by her smartwatch, indicating good cardiovascular fitness from half marathon training.

en.description: The user has a history of patellar tendinitis in her left knee.
en.content: The user experienced patellar tendinitis in her left knee three years ago during a previous marathon training cycle. She now does preventive strengthening exercises to avoid recurrence.

en.description: The user prefers electrolyte chews over gels during long runs.
en.content: For runs longer than 90 minutes, the user consumes gluten-free electrolyte chews rather than gels because gels cause stomach upset. She finds chews easier to digest while running.

en.description: The user has a sports massage appointment every other Thursday.
en.content: The user sees Marta, a sports physiotherapist, every other Thursday at 7 PM for deep tissue massage and mobility work to support her running training.

en.description: The user is following a 12-week Garmin Coach half marathon training plan.
en.content: The user's half marathon training plan from Garmin Coach targets a sub-2:10 finish at the Lisbon Half Marathon. It includes four runs per week: easy, intervals, tempo, and a long run.

en.description: The user avoids high-impact cross-training to protect her knees.
en.content: The user prefers low-impact cross-training such as swimming and cycling to reduce stress on her knees during half marathon preparation.

en.description: The user has a dental cleaning appointment on September 12, 2025.
en.content: The user is scheduled for a routine dental cleaning and check-up with Dr. Silva on September 12, 2025, at 5:30 PM.

en.description: The user has allergic rhinitis triggered by grass pollen.
en.content: The user was diagnosed with allergic rhinitis to grass pollen in her twenties. She takes a daily antihistamine during allergy season to manage sneezing and itchy eyes.

en.description: The user uses a standing desk to reduce lower back pain.
en.content: The user alternates between sitting and standing at her work desk to manage chronic lower back tightness from long design sessions.

en.description: The assistant should not suggest late-night workouts.
en.content: When scheduling exercise, the assistant must not propose workouts after 8 PM because late exercise disrupts the user's sleep quality and leads to insomnia.

en.description: The user tracks sleep with an Oura ring and exports data to a personal dashboard.
en.content: The user wears an Oura ring to sleep; it captures sleep stages, HRV, and temperature. She imports the data into a custom dashboard she built with Python to correlate sleep with training load.

en.description: The user prefers a cool, dark bedroom for optimal sleep.
en.content: The user keeps her bedroom at 18°C with blackout curtains and uses a white noise machine to improve sleep depth and reduce nighttime awakenings.

en.description: The user has a post-race check-up with a sports medicine doctor.
en.content: The user has a post-race check-up with Dr. Fernandes on October 20, 2025, to evaluate her knee and overall recovery after the Lisbon Half Marathon.

en.description: The user is a light sleeper and uses earplugs when traveling.
en.content: The user is a light sleeper, especially in new environments, so she always packs silicone earplugs and an eye mask for trips to ensure restful sleep.

en.description: The user avoids caffeine after 2 PM.
en.content: The user limits caffeine to mornings only; any coffee after 2 PM causes her to have difficulty falling asleep and reduces sleep efficiency.

en.description: The user has a dermatology skin check on August 30, 2025.
en.content: The user has an annual skin exam with Dr. Pereira at Dermatologia Lisboa on August 30, 2025, at 11 AM to monitor a few moles.

en.description: The user does a daily 10-minute hip mobility routine.
en.content: The user follows a daily hip mobility routine with exercises like pigeon pose and leg swings, recommended by her physiotherapist to reduce hip tightness and improve running form.

en.description: The user uses a foam roller every evening.
en.content: The user incorporates foam rolling into her nightly wind-down, focusing on calves, quads, and IT band to reduce muscle soreness and aid recovery.

en.description: The user has mild iron deficiency and takes iron supplements.
en.content: The user has iron deficiency without anemia; she takes a daily iron supplement with orange juice to boost absorption and support endurance training.

en.description: The user has a physiotherapy appointment for dry needling on her calf.
en.content: The user is scheduled for dry needling on her right calf with her physiotherapist on September 5, 2025, to relieve chronic tightness from running.

en.description: The assistant should remind the user to reapply sunscreen before outdoor runs.
en.content: Because the user runs outdoors in sunny Lisbon, the assistant should proactively remind her to apply SPF 50 sunscreen before any daytime run lasting more than 30 minutes.

en.description: The user prefers treadmill running on poor air quality days.
en.content: On days with high pollen or poor air quality, the user opts for indoor treadmill runs to prevent exercise-induced asthma flare-ups and protect her lungs.

en.description: The user wears a Garmin Forerunner 265S for tracking runs and sleep.
en.content: The user uses a Garmin Forerunner 265S with wrist-based heart rate and GPS; she syncs it to both Garmin Connect and her custom sleep dashboard.

en.description: The user has a COVID booster and flu shot appointment on October 2, 2025.
en.content: The user is getting both the updated COVID-19 booster and seasonal flu vaccine at Farmácia Central on October 2, 2025, at 4 PM.

en.description: The user drinks electrolyte water first thing in the morning.
en.content: The user starts her day with 500 mL of water with an electrolyte tablet, especially after morning runs, to maintain hydration and support recovery.

en.description: The user has a family history of type 2 diabetes and monitors glucose annually.
en.content: The user's father has type 2 diabetes, so she gets annual fasting blood glucose tests and maintains a low-sugar diet to reduce her risk.

en.description: The user prefers running on dirt or rubberized paths, not concrete.
en.content: The user chooses dirt or rubberized paths in Monsanto Forest Park or along the Tagus riverfront to minimize joint impact and reduce injury risk.

en.description: The user has a gynecology appointment on February 14, 2026.
en.content: The user has an annual gynecology appointment with Dr. Sousa scheduled for February 14, 2026, at 9 AM.

en.description: The user is following a Mediterranean-style gluten-free diet for training.
en.content: The user is following a Mediterranean-inspired gluten-free eating plan, emphasizing olive oil, fish, legumes, and vegetables, to improve energy and reduce inflammation for half marathon training.

en.description: The assistant must never suggest gluten-containing sports nutrition products.

en.content: The user has a check-in meeting with the bakery owner on May 30, 2025 at 10am to review the new menu page and discuss gluten-free labeling. She will present two Figma mockups and a progress invoice.

en.description: Kitchen demolition starts September 1, 2025.
en.content: The renovation contractor will start kitchen demolition on September 1, 2025. The user will set up a temporary microwave and electric kettle in the living room and expects the kitchen to be out of use for four weeks.

en.description: The user has a group training run on May 24, 2025.
en.content: The user joined a running club for a 10 km training run in Monsanto Forest Park on May 24, 2025 at 7am. She plans to bring her inhaler and run at a conversational pace.

en.description: Kyoto hotel reservation is for November 12-15, 2026.
en.content: The family's Japan trip includes a hotel stay in Kyoto from November 12 to 15, 2026, and they plan to visit Fushimi Inari and Arashiyama. The user needs to book a gluten-free kaiseki dinner in advance.

en.description: Annual performance review is scheduled for October 20, 2025.
en.content: The user's annual performance review with her manager is on October 20, 2025 at 11am. She prepared a portfolio of her design work and a list of salary negotiation points.

en.description: The user is building a renovation budget tracker in Google Sheets.
en.content: The user is tracking all renovation costs in a Google Sheets budget with categories for labor, materials, and permits. She updates it every Sunday evening and compares actuals to her initial estimate.

en.description: The user is compiling a gluten-free restaurant guide for a celiac support group.
en.content: The user volunteered to compile a list of trusted gluten-free restaurants in Lisbon for the Portuguese Celiac Association newsletter. She includes notes on dedicated fryers and staff training.

en.description: The user prefers meeting invites as calendar events with video links.
en.content: For remote meetings, the user wants calendar invitations with a Google Meet link and an agenda in the description. She will not accept meetings scheduled via email body only.

en.description: When teaching Japanese, include furigana and example sentences.
en.content: When the user asks for Japanese vocabulary or grammar help, the assistant should provide kanji with furigana, the polite form, and one example sentence. The user also wants the English translation under each sentence.

en.description: The user likes Notion for simple pages but avoids complex databases.
en.content: The user uses Notion for personal notes, travel planning, and her watercolor journal, preferring simple pages with checklists. She finds relation properties and rollups too complex for her needs.

en.description: A follow-up asthma appointment with Dr. Costa is on October 2, 2025.
en.content: The user has a virtual follow-up with Dr. Costa about her exercise-induced asthma on October 2, 2025 at 4pm. She will discuss whether her current inhaler needs adjusting before the half marathon.

en.description: Beatriz's school summer break starts June 20, 2025.
en.content: Beatriz's school year ends on June 20, 2025, and the user needs to arrange childcare for the first two weeks of July. She is considering a summer camp at the local community center.

en.description: The user prefers audiobooks for long runs and podcasts for short runs.
en.content: While running, the user listens to true crime podcasts on easy runs but switches to audiobooks in Portuguese for long runs over 15 km. She uses wireless earbuds with a secure fit.

en.description: She has a rehearsal for her UX conference talk on May 27, 2025.
en.content: The user scheduled a presentation rehearsal on May 27, 2025 at 9am with her colleague Rita. They will run through the slides for the Barcelona UX conference and time each section.

en.description: When asked for recommendations, give exactly three options with pros and cons.
en.content: The user wants product or restaurant recommendations as exactly three choices, each with a one-sentence pro and con. If she asks for more, the assistant can expand; otherwise, three is the maximum.

en.description: The user has a degree in Communication Design and a postgraduate in Interaction Design.
en.content: The user earned a bachelor's degree in Communication Design from the Universidade de Lisboa and a postgraduate certificate in Interaction Design from IADE. She often applies accessibility heuristics from her academic training.

en.description: Sushi has a grooming appointment on June 5, 2025.
en.content: The family dog Sushi has a grooming appointment on June 5, 2025 at 10am at the local pet salon. The user needs to drop him off before work and pick him up before Beatriz's school pickup.

en.description: The user and Miguel have concert tickets for September 24, 2025.
en.content: The user and Miguel bought tickets for a concert at Coliseu dos Recreios on September 24, 2025. They arranged for Miguel's mother to babysit Beatriz overnight.

en.description: The user is creating a photo book of the Porto trip for her mother's birthday.
en.content: The user is making a digital photo book from their March 2025 trip to Porto as a gift for her mother's birthday on June 28. She uses an online service that prints in Portugal and delivers within a week.

en.description: The user avoids restaurants that only offer gluten-free pasta but no dedicated preparation area.
en.content: The user prefers restaurants that have a separate gluten-free preparation area or a dedicated fryer, not just a gluten-free menu item. She will choose sushi or grilled fish if the only GF option is pasta.

en.description: Avoid using the words 'just' or 'simply' when explaining tasks.
en.content: The user dislikes condescending language like 'just' or 'simply' in step-by-step instructions. The assistant should use neutral imperative phrasing such as 'Do this first' or 'Next, check...'.

en.description: The user's mother lives in Cascais and helps with Beatriz one afternoon a week.
en.content: The user's mother, Teresa, lives in Cascais and picks Beatriz up from school every Wednesday. She is also celiac, so family meals are always gluten-free.

en.description: The mobile app redesign deadline is August 29, 2025.
en.content: The user's mobile app redesign project must be handed off to engineering by August 29, 2025, one week after the design sprint. She plans to work late on August 27 and 28 to finalize developer specs.

zh.description: 用户的职位和雇主。
zh.content: 用户是 Ledgerly 的高级 UX 设计师，这是一家位于里斯本的金融科技初创公司，专注于个人预算工具。

zh.description: 用户的直系家庭成员和狗。
zh.content: 用户与 Miguel 结婚，有一个 5 岁的女儿叫 Beatriz。他们还养了一只叫 Sushi 的救助犬。Beatriz 的学校工作日从 9:00 到 15:30。

zh.description: 用户患有乳糜泻。
zh.content: 用户患有乳糜泻，必须严格避免麸质。交叉污染对她来说是一个严重的问题。

zh.description: 用户正在学习日语，水平为中级。
zh.content: 用户正在学习日语，目前大约在 JLPT N4 水平。她用 WaniKani 学习汉字，每周有 italki 辅导课。

zh.description: 用户在里斯本最喜欢的周末散步路线。
zh.content: 用户住在里斯本的 Graça 区，周末早晨经常带她的狗 Sushi 去 Miradouro da Senhora do Monte 观景台散步。

zh.description: 用户丈夫的工作和工作安排。
zh.content: 用户的丈夫 Miguel 是 OutSystems 的数据工程师，实行混合工作制，每周两天在办公室。

zh.description: 用户患有轻度运动诱发性哮喘。
zh.content: 用户患有轻度运动诱发性哮喘，跑步前 15 分钟使用蓝色的沙丁胺醇吸入器。她在所有锻炼中都随身携带吸入器。

zh.description: 用户持有员工股票期权，并储蓄固定比例的工资。
zh.content: 用户在 Ledgerly 持有员工股票期权，并自动将月薪的 20% 存入一个单独的储蓄账户。

zh.description: 用户正在领导一个移动应用重新设计项目，有严格的截止日期。
zh.content: 用户正在领导 Ledgerly 移动应用的重新设计，截止日期为第三季度末。用户测试会议安排在九月的第二周。

zh.description: 用户正在准备十二月的 JLPT N4 考试。
zh.content: 用户正在准备十二月的日语能力测试 N4。她每晚睡前进行 30 分钟的 Anki 词汇复习。

zh.description: 用户正在为里斯本半程马拉松进行训练。
zh.content: 用户正在为十月的里斯本半程马拉松进行训练。她的计划包括每周四次跑步，周六早上进行长跑。

zh.description: 用户正在翻新她公寓的厨房和浴室。
zh.content: 用户正在翻新她 Graça 公寓的厨房和浴室。总预算为 30,000 欧元，承包商计划于 9 月 1 日开始施工。

zh.description: 用户接了个本地面包店的固定价格网站外包项目。
zh.content: 用户正在为一家本地无麸质面包店做一个自由职业项目，以1500欧元的固定价格设计一个简单的网站。

zh.description: 用户每周和女儿一起画水彩画。
zh.content: 用户和她的女儿Beatriz一起学习水彩画。她们计划每周日下午一起完成一幅小画。

zh.description: 用户正在构建一个个人睡眠追踪仪表板。
zh.content: 用户正在使用Python和Fitbit API构建个人睡眠追踪仪表板。她想找出晚睡屏幕时间和睡眠质量差之间的关联。

zh.description: 用户每周尝试一道无麸质日本菜。
zh.content: 用户每周和家人一起尝试做一道新的无麸质日本菜。最近成功的有玉子烧和用溜酱油做的照烧鸡。

zh.description: 用户已经预订了11月的日本家庭旅行。
zh.content: 用户预订了2026年11月8日至22日的日本家庭旅行。航班是TAP从里斯本到东京，全家会在返回东京前在京都住五晚。

zh.description: 用户将于10月5日参加里斯本半程马拉松。
zh.content: 用户已报名参加2025年10月5日的里斯本半程马拉松。她的目标是在2小时15分钟内完成。

zh.description: 用户将在巴塞罗那的一个UX会议上做演讲。
zh.content: 用户将于9月18日至20日在巴塞罗那的一个UX会议上展示一个案例研究。她的演讲是关于设计无障碍的金融科技界面。

zh.description: 用户的女儿6月14日有学校戏剧演出。
zh.content: Beatriz在6月14日18:00有学校戏剧演出。用户和Miguel计划一起去观看，Beatriz有一个小台词角色。

zh.description: 用户和Miguel在2025年3月去波尔图旅行过。
zh.content: 用户和Miguel在2025年3月的一个周末去了波尔图。他们住在里贝拉区，特别喜欢在Vila Nova de Gaia的一个小酒窖品尝波特酒。

zh.description: 用户已预约了Costa医生的年度体检。
zh.content: 用户与Costa医生预约了7月3日9:30的年度体检。她需要带上最新的血液检查结果。

zh.description: 用户每周参加日语会话聚会。
zh.content: 用户每周四晚上在里斯本市中心的一家语言咖啡馆参加日语会话聚会。她从2026年2月开始参加。

zh.description: 用户6月28日为她母亲准备了生日晚餐。
zh.content: 用户正在组织6月28日19:30为她母亲举办的生日晚餐。选择的餐厅是她母亲要求的一家素食餐厅，用户需要提前确认有无麸质选项。

zh.description: 用户更喜欢无麸质餐厅，并会询问交叉污染情况。
zh.content: 用户更喜欢菜单上明确标注无麸质的餐厅，并且点餐前总会向工作人员询问交叉污染的处理方式。

zh.description: 用户不喜欢香菜，觉得它有肥皂味。
zh.content: 用户非常不喜欢香菜，说尝起来像肥皂。她总是尽可能要求菜里不放香菜。

zh.description: 用户在做 UI 设计时更喜欢用 Figma。
zh.content: 用户在 UI 设计上比起 Sketch 或 Adobe XD 更偏爱 Figma。她非常依赖自动布局和共享组件库。

zh.description: 用户希望工作相关的回复简洁并采用要点列表。
zh.content: 用户希望工作相关的回答简洁并采用要点形式。助手在专业场合应避免使用表情符号，并在相关时包含后续步骤或行动项。

zh.description: 用户喜欢葡萄牙语或英语的文学小说推荐。
zh.content: 用户喜欢文学小说，更倾向于葡萄牙语或英语的书籍推荐。她最近很喜欢小川洋子的《记忆警察》。

zh.description: 用户在航班上更喜欢靠过道的座位和无麸质餐食。
zh.content: 用户在航班上更喜欢靠过道的座位，并且总是提前预订无麸质餐食。她避免预订中转时间很短的航班。

zh.description: 用户在晚上9点后使用深色模式和夜览功能。
zh.content: 用户在所有设备上开启深色模式，并在21:00后使用夜览设置以减少眼睛疲劳。她还在工作用的 MacBook 上使用蓝光滤镜。

zh.description: 用户在跑步时听播客。
zh.content: 用户在跑步时听播客，尤其是真实犯罪和设计相关的节目。她目前最喜欢的是《Criminal》和《99% Invisible》。

zh.description: 助手绝不能建议含麸质的食物或餐厅。
zh.content: 用户患有乳糜泻，所以助手绝不能建议含麸质的食谱或餐厅，并且在讨论食物时必须始终提供无麸质的替代方案。

zh.description: 助手应为贝娅特丽斯的学校起草正式的葡萄牙语消息。
zh.content: 在给贝娅特丽斯的学校起草消息时，助手应使用带“você”的正式葡萄牙语，并将消息控制在150字以内。

zh.description: 在比较软件时，助手应包含离线功能和葡萄牙语支持。
zh.content: 在比较软件或应用时，助手应始终说明产品是否支持离线使用以及是否支持葡萄牙语。

zh.description: 如果用户提到运动后呼吸困难，助手必须提醒她使用吸入器。
zh.content: 如果用户提到运动期间或之后出现呼吸困难、喘息或胸闷，助手必须提醒她立即停止活动并使用她的蓝色沙丁胺醇吸入器。

zh.description: 用户之前的工作单位和职位。
zh.content: 用户之前在波尔图的数字产品机构 PixelCraft 担任了三年 UX 设计师。在加入 FinLumina 之前，她主要负责医疗保健和电子商务客户。

zh.description: 用户的教育背景和学位。
zh.content: 用户拥有里斯本大学传播设计学士学位，于2012年毕业。她仍与设计学院的导师阿尔梅达教授保持联系。

zh.description: 用户偏爱的用户流程图工具。
zh.content: 在项目发现阶段，用户偏好使用 Miro 来创建用户流程图和用户旅程地图。她觉得这样比在纸上画草图更具协作性。

zh.description: 用户在 Figma 之外偏爱的原型制作工具。
zh.content: 对于高保真交互原型，用户更喜欢使用 ProtoPie 而不是 Figma 内置的原型功能，因为它支持更高级的微交互和条件逻辑。

zh.description: 用户当前直接管理的下属。
zh.content: 用户目前管理一名初级 UX 设计师 Carolina，并在设计系统和利益相关者沟通方面指导她。

zh.description: 用户当前应用改版项目的截止日期。
zh.content: 用户正在主导 FinLumina 消费银行应用的重设计，内部项目名为“Projeto Aurora”。第一版发布的截止日期是2026年3月31日，其中包括全新的引导流程和仪表板。

zh.description: 用户的面包店网站自由职业项目的详细信息。
zh.content: 用户为一家名为“Padaria da Esquina”的本地面包店做的自由职业项目，包括建立一个带有在线订购系统的 WordPress 网站。她使用 Figma 进行设计，并与自由职业开发者 Marcos 合作，网站必须在8月15日之前上线。

zh.description: 用户在工作中偏爱的沟通渠道。
zh.content: 用户喜欢用 Slack 进行快速提问和异步更新，但只在与外部合作伙伴或人力资源部门进行正式沟通时才使用电子邮件。她不喜欢计划外的视频通话。

zh.description: 用户的典型工作日程。
zh.content: 用户通常采用混合工作制：周二、周三和周四在办公室，周一和周五远程办公。她上午9点开始工作，下午6点左右下班，下午1点午休。

zh.description: 如何为用户整理会议记录。
zh.content: 助手应将会议记录整理为：决策摘要、带有负责人和截止日期的行动项列表，以及任何阻碍事项。用户希望用项目符号列表而不是段落文字。

zh.description: 用户偏爱的开发人员交接工具。
zh.content: 尽管 Figma 有内置的规格说明，但用户更喜欢使用 Zeplin 进行最终设计的开发人员交接，因为她的工程团队习惯了 Zeplin 的注释功能。

zh.description: 用户的汇报关系及重要同事。
zh.content: 用户直接向产品副总裁 Sofia Martins 汇报，并与产品经理 João Silva 在优先级排序方面紧密合作。

zh.description: 用户正在构建一个设计系统。
zh.content: 用户目前正在为FinLumina构建一个设计系统，以统一Web和移动应用之间的UI组件。它被称为'Sistema Lume'，她正在使用Figma的库和Tokens Studio进行设计令牌。

zh.description: 用户进行设计评审的方法。
zh.content: 用户更喜欢设计评审专注于特定的用户流程，而不是一般的美学。她要求以'你会改变什么，为什么？'的形式提供反馈，而不是开放式的意见。

zh.description: 用户即将在UX大会上进行演讲。
zh.content: 用户计划于2026年6月5日在巴塞罗那的UX Spain大会上发表题为'为金融科技中的信任而设计'的演讲。她需要在5月20日之前准备好幻灯片。

zh.description: 用户对自由职业与工作项目管理的工具偏好。
zh.content: 用户在她的全职工作中使用Jira进行项目跟踪，但在她的自由职业面包店网站项目上更喜欢使用Trello，因为它更简单并且面向客户。

zh.description: 用户如何跟踪她的股票期权和储蓄。
zh.content: 用户在每个月的第一个周日审查她的股票期权归属时间表和投资账户。她使用电子表格来跟踪预计的归属价值，并在需要时调整她的储蓄率。

zh.description: 用户在面包店项目之前的自由职业项目。
zh.content: 在面包店网站之前，用户在2024年为当地的一家瑜伽工作室做自由职业，设计了一个简单的预订网站。这个项目帮助她决定承担更多的自由职业工作。

zh.description: 用户使用用户研究工具的方法。
zh.content: 用户更喜欢使用Maze进行无主持的可用性测试，因为它可以直接与她的Figma原型集成。在最终确定设计之前，她会为每个流程至少运行5名用户的测试。

zh.description: 用户之前在银行业的雇主。
zh.content: 在加入代理机构之前，用户作为UX设计师在葡萄牙大型银行Millennium BCP工作了两年，在那里她了解了金融法规和银行业的设计限制。

zh.description: 用户对远程工作和会议时间的看法。
zh.content: 用户重视远程工作，并发现她在家早上工作效率最高。她宁愿在上午10点之前不开会，以保留深度工作时间。

zh.description: 用户应用重新设计的性能目标。
zh.content: 用户的重新设计项目有一个可衡量的目标：在发布后三个月内将应用引导流失率降低20%，并将首周留存率提高10%。她每周与数据团队一起跟踪进展。

zh.description: 用户持续的专业发展。
zh.content: 用户正在参加交互设计基金会提供的设计领导力在线课程，为可能的团队领导角色做准备。她在Beatriz上床睡觉后在工作日的晚上学习。

zh.description: 用户对设计可访问性的标准。
zh.content: 用户在设计界面时使用Figma中的Stark插件来检查对比度并模拟色盲，并坚持所有发布的功能都符合WCAG AA标准。

zh.description: 用户过去的设计冲刺工作坊。
zh.content: 2026年3月，用户主持了一场为期5天的设计冲刺，以确定应用重新设计的引导流程。成果是一个纸质原型，后来对8名用户进行了测试。

zh.description: 助手应如何处理设计反馈请求的方式。
zh.content: 当用户请求对设计想法提供反馈时，助手应首先询问有关目标用户和背景的澄清性问题，然后提供参考设计原则的可操作建议，而不仅仅是审美意见。

zh.description: 用户每日站会的时间。
zh.content: 用户每天上午9:30（里斯本时间）通过Google Meet参加站会，在会议上她汇报设计任务和阻碍。她希望自己的更新控制在2分钟以内。

zh.description: 用户对工作设计工具的主题偏好。
zh.content: 用户在Figma和其他设计工具中全天保持深色模式，因为她觉得在办公室明亮的灯光下浅色主题太刺眼。

zh.description: 用户工作时的办公桌配置。
zh.content: 用户在FinLumina办公室有一张可升降办公桌，并使用一台27英寸4K显示器和她的MacBook Pro。在长时间设计过程中，她更喜欢使用罗技MX Master 3鼠标以获得人体工学舒适度。

zh.description: 用户对设计文件版本控制的方法。
zh.content: 用户更喜欢在重大重新设计中使用Figma的分支功能，并在设计评审后合并分支。她避免为同一项目使用多个文件以防止混乱。

zh.description: 用户即将进行的设计评审会议。
zh.content: 用户将于2026年4月20日与工程负责人Rita进行一次设计评审，以最终确定应用重新设计的组件库。她需要准备一份所有可复用组件的清单。

zh.description: 用户在工作书面沟通中的语气。
zh.content: 用户在工作邮件和消息中更喜欢直接、简洁的语气，避免过多的客套话。她经常使用项目符号并加粗关键行动项。

zh.description: 用户的职业抱负。
zh.content: 用户渴望在未来两年内成为一名设计经理，并正在积极寻求机会领导应用重新设计之外的跨职能项目。

zh.description: 用户因为口感不喜欢蘑菇。
zh.content: 用户觉得蘑菇的口感令人不快，在餐馆点菜时总是要求去掉蘑菇。她在家做饭时也避免购买蘑菇。

zh.description: 用户喜欢寿司和生鱼片，并且总是自带无麸质酱油。
zh.content: 用户喜欢寿司和生鱼片，因为它们天然不含麸质，但她总是自带一瓶无麸质酱油去餐馆，以避免含小麦的酱油。她的手提包里有一个小旅行装的容器。

zh.description: 用户最喜欢的安慰食物是无麸质的葡萄牙甘蓝汤。
zh.content: 用户最喜欢的安慰食物是葡萄牙甘蓝汤，一种由羽衣甘蓝和土豆制成的汤。她在家制作时使用经认证的无麸质葡式香肠，并搭配玉米面包。

zh.description: 用户有一个小阳台香草园。
zh.content: 用户在自家小阳台上种了罗勒、欧芹和薄荷。她在烹饪中使用这些新鲜香草，尤其是做沙拉和葡萄牙菜时。

zh.description: 用户早上喜欢喝浓黑咖啡。
zh.content: 用户每天以一杯不加糖的浓黑咖啡开始一天。她从里斯本当地的一家烘焙店购买整豆，每天早上现磨。

zh.description: 用户在温暖的夜晚喜欢喝一杯青酒。
zh.content: 用户喜欢在温暖的夜晚放松时喝一杯干型青酒（一种年轻的葡萄牙葡萄酒）。她喜欢稍微冰一下，通常搭配烤鱼或沙拉。

zh.description: 用户避免普通啤酒，但喜欢某个特定的无麸质品牌。
zh.content: 由于患有乳糜泻，用户避免所有未经认证无麸质的啤酒。她尝试过几个品牌，更喜欢葡萄牙一家微型酿酒厂的“无麸质啤酒”，她会在特殊场合购买。

zh.description: 用户喜欢微辣到中辣的口味。
zh.content: 用户不太喜欢过于辛辣的食物，更喜欢微辣到中辣。点餐时，她会要求把辣酱放在一边，以便自己控制用量。

zh.description: 用户在办公桌里备有无麸质零食。
zh.content: 用户在办公桌上放着米饼配杏仁酱和香蕉片作为常备零食。她还存了一些无麸质燕麦棒，供忙碌的下午食用。

zh.description: 用户正在努力完善无麸质酸面团酵头。
zh.content: 用户目前正在尝试无麸质酸面团酵头，试验不同的面粉混合物，如糙米和高粱。她每个周末烤一个小面包，并根据结果调整水合和发酵时间。

zh.description: 用户每周日为工作周备餐。
zh.content: 用户把周日下午专门用于为工作周备餐。她煮一大锅藜麦，烤一盘混合蔬菜，并煎鸡胸肉，分装到容器里作为午餐。

zh.description: 用户有一台空气炸锅，经常使用。
zh.content: 用户厨房里有一台空气炸锅，她用它做快速的无麸质餐点，如鸡翅、烤土豆和蔬菜脆片。她觉得它比传统烤箱更快、更容易清洗。

zh.description: 用户和她女儿每周六做无麸质煎饼。
zh.content: 每周六早上，用户和女儿比阿特丽斯一起用特定的大米和木薯粉混合物做无麸质煎饼。她们在上面放上新鲜水果，淋上一点蜂蜜。

zh.description: 用户做晚饭时听美食播客。
zh.content: 准备晚餐时，用户会听美食播客，通常是无麸质烘焙或葡萄牙菜相关的节目。这与她在锻炼时听的跑步播客是分开的。

zh.description: 用户订阅了每周有机蔬菜箱配送服务。
zh.content: 用户订阅了当地农场每周一次的有机蔬菜箱，每周二送到她的公寓。她根据蔬菜内容来计划餐食，经常把多余的蔬菜分给邻居。

zh.description: 用户冬天用慢炖锅炖菜。
zh.content: 在寒冷的月份，用户用慢炖锅做大量无麸质炖菜和汤，比如牛肉蔬菜炖菜或扁豆汤。她会把部分冷冻起来，以备忙碌的工作日晚上食用。

zh.description: 用户在里斯本最喜欢的无麸质餐厅是阿尔法玛区的一家小酒馆。
zh.content: 用户最喜欢的无麸质餐厅是里斯本阿尔法玛区一家叫做'Tasca Sem Glúten'的小酒馆。她总是点烤鲈鱼配炒青菜，并且信任他们专门的无麸质炸锅来做土豆配菜。

zh.description: 用户会在网上查看餐厅菜单，并提前打电话询问无麸质选项。
zh.content: 外出就餐前，用户总是先在网上查看餐厅菜单上的无麸质标签，然后提前打电话询问交叉污染的做法，比如是否有单独的炸锅和准备区域。她手机里存了一个问题清单，以备询问。

zh.description: 用户在2025年5月参加了一个无麸质烹饪课程。
zh.content: 2025年5月，用户在里斯本的'Cozinha Sem Glúten'参加了一个无麸质烹饪课程，在那里她学会了从头开始制作新鲜的无麸质意面和罗勒青酱。她在日常家庭烹饪中经常使用从那个课程中学到的技巧。

zh.description: 用户会避开中餐馆，除非它们宣传有无麸质选项。
zh.content: 用户倾向于避开中餐馆，因为大多数菜肴可能使用含小麦的酱油。她只会去那些明确宣传有无麸质菜单并且员工接受过过敏原处理培训的餐厅。

zh.description: 用户知道Time Out Market哪些摊位提供无麸质选项。
zh.content: 在里斯本的Time Out Market，用户心中有一份提供无麸质菜肴的摊位清单，比如寿司摊位和烤鱼柜台。她会避开油炸食品摊位，因为共用炸锅。

zh.description: 用户信任一家特定的披萨店做无麸质披萨。
zh.content: 用户常去的披萨店是'Pizzaria Sem Glúten'，它提供经过认证的无麸质饼底，并使用单独的烤箱以避免交叉污染。她总是点玛格丽特披萨，多加新鲜罗勒。

zh.description: 用户早上起床先喝一杯温柠檬水。
zh.content: 用户每天早上起床先喝一杯加了新鲜柠檬汁的温水，然后再喝咖啡。她认为这有助于消化。

zh.description: 用户每周有三天早餐喝绿色奶昔。
zh.content: 每周有三天，用户早餐会做一杯绿色奶昔，原料有菠菜、香蕉、菠萝和一勺无麸质蛋白粉。她还会加一汤匙亚麻籽来增加纤维。

zh.description: 用户外出就餐时更喜欢喝加青柠的气泡水。
zh.content: 外出就餐时，用户更喜欢点一杯加青柠片的气泡水，而不是苏打水，因为她想避免饮水机饮料中可能隐藏的麸质，而且她更喜欢清淡的选择。

zh.description: 用户在特殊场合会买一种特定的无麸质啤酒。
zh.content: 在家庆祝特殊场合时，用户会买一瓶她最喜欢的无麸质啤酒'Cerveja Sem Glúten'，并且用她自己的杯子喝，以确保不会因为共用玻璃杯而造成交叉污染。

zh.description: 用户7月10日在'Tasca Sem Glúten'预订了周年纪念晚餐。
zh.content: 用户已经在'Tasca Sem Glúten'预订了一张双人桌，用于7月10日的结婚纪念日晚餐。她已经要求了无麸质甜点选项，并确认了餐厅的交叉污染协议。

zh.description: 用户主要在Continente购买食品杂货，并检查标签是否含麸质。
zh.content: 她在当地的Continente超市进行主要食品杂货采购，使用会员卡享受折扣。她仔细阅读每个标签，寻找含麸质的成分，并经常在健康食品区多花时间。

zh.description: 用户在网上订购无麸质特制产品。
zh.content: 她定期从一家名为“Mercado Sem Glúten”的葡萄牙网店订购特制无麸质产品，包括面包、意大利面和酱油。她保存了购物车，里面有常购商品，以便快速再次下单。

zh.description: 用户避免酱料和加工食品中的隐藏麸质。
zh.content: 她警惕地阅读配料表，寻找隐藏的麸质，尤其是在酱料、调味料和加工肉类中。她避免任何含有麦芽、改性食品淀粉或水解小麦蛋白的产品，除非明确认证为无麸质。

zh.description: 用户在白板上计划每周餐食，并带着清单购物。
zh.content: 她在厨房的白板上计划每周餐食，并制定相应的购物清单以避免冲动购物。这有助于她坚持食品预算并减少食物浪费。

zh.description: 用户周六和女儿一起去农贸市场购物。
zh.content: 周六早上，她带女儿Beatriz去当地的农贸市场购买有机蔬菜和水果。她们喜欢一起挑选时令农产品，并经常在附近的面包店停下来买一个无麸质糕点。

zh.description: 助手应以公制单位和无麸质替代品来格式化食谱。
zh.content: 当助手提供食谱时，应使用公制测量单位（克、毫升），提供配料替代品以使菜肴无麸质，并添加准备过程中可能交叉污染的警告。助手还应避免建议任何含麸质的配料。

zh.description: 用户喜欢清晨跑步。
zh.content: 她喜欢在清晨大约6:30跑步，以避开里斯本的高温，并在晚上有家庭时间。她发现晨跑还能改善睡眠质量。

zh.description: 用户的静息心率为58次/分钟。
zh.content: 她的静息心率为每分钟58次，由智能手表测量，表明半程马拉松训练带来的良好心血管健康。

zh.description: 用户左膝有髌腱炎病史。
zh.content: 三年前，她在一次马拉松训练周期中左膝出现髌腱炎。现在她做预防性强化锻炼以避免复发。

zh.description: 长跑时，用户更喜欢电解质咀嚼片而不是凝胶。
zh.content: 对于超过90分钟的跑步，她食用无麸质电解质咀嚼片而不是凝胶，因为凝胶会引起胃部不适。她发现跑步时咀嚼片更容易消化。

zh.description: 用户每隔一个周四有运动按摩预约。
zh.content: 她每隔一个周四晚上7点见运动物理治疗师Marta，进行深层组织按摩和灵活性训练，以支持她的跑步训练。

zh.description: 用户正在遵循一个12周的Garmin Coach半程马拉松训练计划。
zh.content: 她的Garmin Coach半程马拉松训练计划目标是在里斯本半程马拉松中跑进2小时10分。计划包括每周四次跑步：轻松跑、间歇跑、节奏跑和长距离跑。

zh.description: 用户避免高强度交叉训练以保护膝盖。
zh.content: 用户更喜欢低冲击的交叉训练，如游泳和骑自行车，以减少半程马拉松准备期间膝盖的压力。

zh.description: 用户于2025年9月12日有一次洗牙预约。
zh.content: 用户预约了于2025年9月12日下午5:30与Silva医生进行的常规洗牙和检查。

zh.description: 用户患有由草花粉引发的过敏性鼻炎。
zh.content: 用户在二十多岁时被诊断出对草花粉过敏的过敏性鼻炎。她在过敏季节每天服用抗组胺药来控制打喷嚏和眼睛发痒。

zh.description: 用户使用站立式办公桌来减轻下背部疼痛。
zh.content: 用户在工作时交替坐和站，以管理长时间设计工作导致的慢性下背部紧张。

zh.description: 助手不应建议深夜锻炼。
zh.content: 在安排锻炼时，助手不得建议晚上8点后的锻炼，因为晚锻炼会破坏用户的睡眠质量并导致失眠。

zh.description: 用户使用Oura戒指追踪睡眠，并将数据导出到个人仪表板。
zh.content: 用户睡觉时佩戴Oura戒指；它捕捉睡眠阶段、HRV和温度。她将数据导入她用Python构建的自定义仪表板，以将睡眠与训练负荷相关联。

zh.description: 用户偏好凉爽、黑暗的卧室以获得最佳睡眠。
zh.content: 用户将卧室保持在18°C，使用遮光窗帘，并使用白噪音机来改善睡眠深度并减少夜间醒来。

zh.description: 用户有一场与运动医学医生的赛后检查。
zh.content: 用户于2025年10月20日与Fernandes医生进行赛后检查，以评估她在里斯本半程马拉松后的膝盖和整体恢复情况。

zh.description: 用户睡眠浅，旅行时使用耳塞。
zh.content: 用户睡眠浅，尤其是在新环境中，所以她旅行时总是带上硅胶耳塞和眼罩以确保安稳睡眠。

zh.description: 用户避免在下午2点后摄入咖啡因。
zh.content: 用户将咖啡因限制在早晨；下午2点后任何咖啡都会导致她难以入睡并降低睡眠效率。

zh.description: 用户于2025年8月30日有一次皮肤科检查。
zh.content: 用户于2025年8月30日上午11点在里斯本皮肤科与Pereira医生进行年度皮肤检查，以监测几颗痣。

zh.description: 用户每天进行10分钟的髋部灵活性训练。
zh.content: 用户按照物理治疗师的建议，每天进行髋部灵活性训练，包括鸽子式和摆腿等练习，以减少髋部紧张并改善跑步姿势。

zh.description: 用户每天晚上用泡沫轴。
zh.content: 她把泡沫轴滚动融入了每晚的放松流程，重点是小腿、股四头肌和髂胫束，以减少肌肉酸痛、帮助恢复。

zh.description: 用户有轻微的缺铁，正在服用铁补充剂。
zh.content: 她缺铁但没有贫血；每天用橙汁送服铁补充剂，以提高吸收率，支持耐力训练。

zh.description: 用户有个小腿干针的理疗预约。
zh.content: 她预约了2025年9月5日由理疗师对右小腿做干针治疗，以缓解跑步引起的慢性紧绷。

zh.description: 助手应该在户外跑步前提醒用户补涂防晒霜。
zh.content: 因为用户在阳光充足的里斯本户外跑步，助手应主动提醒她在任何超过30分钟的日间跑步前涂抹SPF 50防晒霜。

zh.description: 空气质量差的日子里，用户更喜欢在跑步机上跑。
zh.content: 在花粉多或空气质量差的日子里，她选择在室内跑跑步机，以预防运动引发的哮喘发作，保护肺部。

zh.description: 用户佩戴佳明 Forerunner 265S 来追踪跑步和睡眠。
zh.content: 她使用配备腕式心率和GPS的佳明 Forerunner 265S；她将其同步到Garmin Connect以及自己定制的睡眠仪表板。

zh.description: 用户预约了2025年10月2日接种新冠加强针和流感疫苗。
zh.content: 她将于2025年10月2日下午4点在中央药房接种更新版新冠加强针和季节性流感疫苗。

zh.description: 用户早上第一件事就是喝电解质水。
zh.content: 她每天以500毫升水加一片电解质片开始一天，尤其是在晨跑后，以保持水分和帮助恢复。

zh.description: 用户有2型糖尿病家族史，每年监测血糖。
zh.content: 她的父亲患有2型糖尿病，所以她每年做空腹血糖检测，并保持低糖饮食以降低风险。

zh.description: 用户更喜欢在泥土或橡胶跑道上跑步，而不是水泥地。
zh.content: 她选择蒙桑托森林公园或塔霍河边的泥土或橡胶跑道，以尽量减少关节冲击，降低受伤风险。

zh.description: 用户预约了2026年2月14日的妇科检查。
zh.content: 她与苏萨医生的年度妇科预约定在2026年2月14日上午9点。

zh.description: 用户正在为训练采用地中海风格的无麸质饮食。
zh.content: 她正在采用地中海风味、无麸质的饮食计划，以橄榄油、鱼、豆类和蔬菜为主，以提高能量、减少炎症，为半程马拉松训练做准备。

zh.description: 助手绝对不能推荐含麸质的运动营养产品。
zh.content: 在推荐能量棒、凝胶或补水混合饮品时，助手必须确认它们是无麸质认证的，因为用户患有乳糜泻。即使是交叉污染的产品也不安全。

zh.description: 用户因脱水和睡眠不足而引发偏头痛。
zh.content: 如果用户脱水或睡眠少于6小时，她就会偏头痛；她根据需要服用舒马曲坦，并优先保证规律睡眠和补水以预防发作。

zh.description: 对于超过15公里的长跑，用户更喜欢穿水袋背心。
zh.content: 对于长跑，用户会携带一个轻便的水袋背心，里面有两个500毫升的软水壶和一个放手机和吸入器的口袋，而不是依赖饮水机。

zh.description: Beatriz学校的名称和年级。
zh.content: Beatriz就读于里斯本的Bairro Alto基础学校，在5岁儿童的学前班。

zh.description: Beatriz即将到来的生日派对详情。
zh.content: Beatriz的6岁生日是在9月12日，用户计划在当地公园举办一个恐龙主题的派对，邀请她班上大约15个孩子。

zh.description: Beatriz最喜欢的睡前故事类型。
zh.content: Beatriz喜欢关于神奇生物的故事，尤其是独角兽和龙，她要求用户每晚睡前给她读一个。

zh.description: Miguel自酿啤酒的爱好。
zh.content: Miguel自酿啤酒已经三年了，每个月都会酿造不同风格的啤酒；他和朋友及家人分享。

zh.description: 全家最喜欢的周末早餐咖啡馆。
zh.content: 星期天，用户、Miguel、Beatriz和Sushi会步行去Príncipe Real一家允许带狗的咖啡馆，那里提供无麸质煎饼，还有一个供孩子们玩耍的小区域。

zh.description: Sushi的品种和年龄。
zh.content: Sushi是一只7岁的柴犬，它平静且乖巧，但当门铃响时会变得非常警觉。

zh.description: Miguel的生日和典型的庆祝方式。
zh.content: Miguel的生日是2月14日，他们通常会在家安静地吃一顿晚餐，配上一个自制的无麸质蛋糕，因为用户患有乳糜泻。

zh.description: Beatriz最喜欢的父女活动。
zh.content: Beatriz喜欢和Miguel一起搭乐高积木；他们在客厅有一个专门的角落，用于他们正在进行的乐高城市项目。

zh.description: 正在进行的家庭项目：建造树屋。
zh.content: 用户和Miguel已经开始为Beatriz设计一个小树屋，但他们要等公寓装修完成后再购买材料。

zh.description: Beatriz 的花生过敏及应急计划。
zh.content: Beatriz 有轻微的花生过敏；她在学校和家里都备有 EpiPen，用户已经告知老师万一意外接触该怎么办。助手必须避免向 Beatriz 推荐任何含有花生的食物。

zh.description: Beatriz 在学校最好的朋友。
zh.content: Beatriz 最好的朋友是一个叫 Matilde 的女孩，她们经常在周五下午一起玩耍。

zh.description: 每周与 Miguel 父母的视频通话。
zh.content: 每周日下午 6 点，全家会和住在波尔图的 Miguel 父母视频通话；Beatriz 会给他们看她的画。

zh.description: 偏好的家庭度假类型。
zh.content: 全家喜欢节奏慢的假期，结合户外活动和文化参观，避开拥挤的旅游景点；他们喜欢租带厨房的公寓，这样可以自己烹饪无麸质餐食。

zh.description: Sushi 的兽医护理和饮食需求。
zh.content: Sushi 肠胃敏感，吃一种特制的无谷物饮食；用户每两个月在网上订购他的食物，并每年带他去当地兽医诊所找 Pereira 医生做体检。

zh.description: 结婚纪念日日期。
zh.content: 用户和 Miguel 于 9 月 20 日结婚，他们通过重访第一次约会的餐厅来庆祝。

zh.description: Miguel 最喜欢的用户做的无麸质餐。
zh.content: Miguel 喜欢用户做的无麸质马介休炒薯丝（bacalhau à brás），用户用玉米淀粉代替小麦面粉来做。

zh.description: Beatriz 的课后活动。
zh.content: Beatriz 周二和周四在当地游泳池上游泳课，周六在社区中心上儿童美术班。

zh.description: 已安排的家长会。
zh.content: 用户将于 10 月 2 日下午 4 点与 Beatriz 的老师开家长会，讨论 Beatriz 在幼儿园的进步。

zh.description: Miguel 的家庭和成长背景。
zh.content: Miguel 在波尔图长大，有两个姐姐，他的整个家庭仍住在葡萄牙北部；他们每年至少回去探望两次。

zh.description: 家庭游戏之夜的偏好。
zh.content: 周五晚上全家会玩桌游；Beatriz 目前最喜欢的是“我的第一套卡卡颂”，而用户和 Miguel 在 Beatriz 睡觉后喜欢玩“瘟疫危机”这样的合作游戏。

zh.description: Sushi 的美容预约。
zh.content: 下个月第一个周六，Sushi 在公园附近的宠物美容院有美容预约；用户提醒自己等装修结束后就预约。

zh.description: Miguel 下班后的放松方式。
zh.content: 远程工作了一整天后，Miguel 喜欢带着 Sushi 沿着河边散步，一边听历史播客。

zh.description: 用户的亲密朋友和定期社交活动。
zh.content: 用户有三个大学时期的亲密朋友——Joana、Rita 和 Sofia——他们每个月都会轮流在不同的餐厅聚会，吃一顿无麸质晚餐。

zh.description: 家庭活动规划的考虑因素。
zh.content: 在建议家庭活动时，助手应确保活动适合 5 岁孩子，并为用户提供无麸质食品选择，同时还要确认场地是否提供适合儿童的餐食。

zh.description: Beatriz 即将到来的学校实地考察。
zh.content: Beatriz 的班级将于 3 月 20 日去里斯本海洋馆实地考察，用户自愿担任陪同家长。

zh.description: 最喜欢的家庭野餐公园。
zh.content: 这家人喜欢周日下午在 Jardim da Estrela 野餐，带上无麸质三明治，让 Sushi 在狗狗活动区里奔跑。

zh.description: Miguel 工作安排的灵活性和家庭责任。
zh.content: Miguel 的远程工作让他可以在周三去学校接 Beatriz；他会早上提前工作来弥补时间。

zh.description: Beatriz 学校戏剧排练时间的变更。
zh.content: Beatriz 的学校戏剧排练从下周开始改到周一和周五下午 3:30 至 5 点，所以用户需要调整接她的安排。

zh.description: 最喜欢的约会之夜活动。
zh.content: 约会之夜，用户和 Miguel 喜欢尝试里斯本新开的无麸质餐厅，通常会参考用户手机里保存的清单；他们避开繁忙的周末，更喜欢周二或周三晚上。

zh.description: Sushi 最喜欢的玩具和怪癖。
zh.content: Sushi 最喜欢的玩具是一个会吱吱作响的寿司卷毛绒玩具，他习惯把它藏在沙发底下；他晚上散步后还会变得很兴奋（疯跑）。

zh.description: 计划中的家庭海滩之旅（前往阿尔加维）。
zh.content: 这家人计划 8 月底去阿尔加维度假一周，住在一栋带围栏院子的出租屋里，方便 Sushi 活动。

zh.description: Beatriz 的就寝时间和日程限制。
zh.content: 助手应避免建议在上学日晚上 7 点以后开始的家庭活动，因为 Beatriz 晚上 8 点就要睡觉，需要一段放松时间。

zh.description: Miguel 的饮品偏好和无麸质考虑。
zh.content: Miguel 喜欢精酿啤酒，但由于用户患有乳糜泻不能喝普通啤酒，所以他们经常买无麸质啤酒，或者在一起时 Miguel 喝苹果酒。

zh.description: 用户和她的丈夫在2025年3月乘坐Alfa Pendular列车前往波尔图。
zh.content: 用户和Miguel在2025年3月乘火车从里斯本到波尔图，度过了一个长周末。他们住在里贝拉区，还参观了几家波特酒酒窖。

zh.description: 对于五天以内的旅行，用户更喜欢只携带随身行李。
zh.content: 短途旅行时，用户不托运行李以节省时间并降低丢失风险。她有一个心仪的葡萄牙品牌轻便登机箱。

zh.description: 用户已经订好了去巴塞罗那参加UX大会的机票和酒店。
zh.content: 用户10月20日从里斯本飞巴塞罗那，在会场附近酒店住两晚。她选了过道座位，还订了无麸质餐。

zh.description: 用户订了去日本的往返机票，中途在迪拜转机。
zh.content: 用户发现2026年11月坐阿联酋航空从里斯本经迪拜飞东京更便宜。她选转机是为了让女儿长途飞行不那么累。

zh.description: 用户在京都订了一间传统町屋，住四晚。
zh.content: 去日本的时候，用户订了京都祇园的一间翻新町屋，住四晚。选它是因为有厨房，能自己做无麸质的饭。

zh.description: 用户坐火车喜欢靠窗，好看风景。
zh.content: 坐火车的时候，用户总是订右边靠窗的位置，这样从里斯本到波尔图能看到最美的海岸线。

zh.description: 用户2024年夏天和家人去了马德拉岛。
zh.content: 2024年8月，用户一家三口（她、老公和女儿）在马德拉岛玩了一周。租了车去走列瓦达徒步路线，住在丰沙尔。

zh.description: 用户给全家买了7天的日本铁路周游券。
zh.content: 用户给自己和老公买了7天的JR Pass，这样11月去东京、京都、大阪之间坐火车都包括了。她算过，比单买票划算。

zh.description: 用户特别看重航空公司能不能靠谱地提供无麸质餐。
zh.content: 因为得了乳糜泻，用户订票前会查航空公司无麸质餐的评价。长途的话，除非能自己带吃的，否则她不坐廉航。

zh.description: 用户打算九月周末开车去阿连特茹玩。
zh.content: 九月中旬，用户一家会开车去阿连特茹埃武拉附近的一个农场住。她订了个带小厨房的小屋，方便自己做无麸质餐。

zh.description: 用户用Google Flights跟踪机票价格，设价格提醒。
zh.content: 用户靠Google Flights的价格提醒盯着以后行程的票价。她设了里斯本到东京和里斯本到巴塞罗那的提醒。

zh.description: 用户在整理东京、京都、大阪的无麸质餐厅清单。
zh.content: 为了日本之行，用户做了个共享地图，把东京、京都、大阪那些认证过的无麸质餐厅和咖啡馆都标上了。她还会参考当地乳糜泻病友群和谷歌评价来核实。

zh.description: 用户更喜欢早班航班以减少延误风险。
zh.content: 用户尽可能预订当天第一班航班，因为她发现早班航班延误的可能性更小，而且到达后有更多时间。

zh.description: 用户在2025年2月参加了伦敦的一场设计冲刺活动。
zh.content: 2025年2月，用户飞往伦敦，与她金融科技公司的英国团队进行了为期两天的设计冲刺。她住在国王十字车站附近，回来后对英国文学小说重新产生了兴趣。

zh.description: 用户为家人在京都预订了一场私人茶道体验。
zh.content: 用户在京都的一座传统房屋里为自己、丈夫和女儿安排了一场私人茶道。她选择了一家能提供无麸质和果子的服务商。

zh.description: 当用户提到为了比赛或跑步而旅行时，助手必须提醒她带上吸入器。
zh.content: 当用户讨论包含跑步活动或训练跑的即将到来的旅行时，助手应主动提醒她带上急救吸入器。这很重要，因为她的运动性哮喘在新环境中可能会发作。

zh.description: 由于晕车，用户避免乘坐长途巴士。
zh.content: 用户乘坐超过两小时的巴士会晕车，所以更喜欢火车或汽车。只有在没有其他选择时，她才会考虑巴士，并且会提前服药。

zh.description: 用户在东京站附近的一家酒店预订了家庭房。
zh.content: 在日本之行的第一部分，用户在距离东京站步行可达的一家商务酒店预订了家庭房。她选择这里是因为方便乘坐新干线，而且酒店提供无麸质早餐。

zh.description: 用户在2025年春天去了佩内达-热雷斯国家公园徒步。
zh.content: 2025年5月，用户和米格尔带着寿司（宠物名）去佩内达-热雷斯进行了一次周末徒步旅行。他们住在一间允许携带宠物的小木屋里，完成了一条10公里的步道。

zh.description: 用户计划为日本之行租赁一台便携式WiFi设备。
zh.content: 用户正在比较便携式WiFi租赁和当地SIM卡两种方案，以供日本之行使用。她最终决定选择随身WiFi设备，这样一家三口都能连接设备。

zh.description: 用户更喜欢住在以提供无麸质早餐而闻名的连锁酒店。
zh.content: 预订酒店时，用户会寻找像雅高或洲际这样提供明确标注无麸质早餐的连锁品牌。她会查看网上评价，并提前打电话确认是否采取措施防止交叉污染。

zh.description: 用户计划八月份和女儿一起去辛特拉一日游。
zh.content: 用户计划八月份带比阿特丽斯去辛特拉一日游，参观佩纳宫。她们将从里斯本乘火车前往，并带上野餐，包括无麸质三明治。

zh.description: 用户2019年在亚速尔群岛度了蜜月。
zh.content: 2019年9月，用户和米格尔在亚速尔群岛的圣米格尔岛度蜜月。他们租了辆车，游览了七城湖和富尔纳斯。

zh.description: 用户正在研究如何用日语表达乳糜泻需求。
zh.content: 用户制作了一张日语短语卡片，向餐厅员工解释她的乳糜泻和无麸质需求。她练习了“コムギアレルギーがあります”这句话，并附上了关于交叉污染的书面说明。

zh.description: 用户会为超过六小时的航班付费选择更大的腿部空间座位。
zh.content: 对于长途航班，用户会选择紧急出口排或舱壁座位以获得更大的腿部空间，即使这意味着要支付少量费用。她会尽可能使用航空公司的忠诚度积分来升舱。

zh.description: 用户将在六月开车去科英布拉参加她母亲的生日晚宴。
zh.content: 用户和她的家人将在6月28日开车去科英布拉参加她母亲的生日晚宴。她计划早点出发以避开交通，并会带上一份无麸质甜点。

zh.description: 用户对气流颠簸有轻微的恐惧，但会用降噪耳机和冥想来应对。
zh.content: 用户在飞行中遇到气流颠簸时会感到轻度焦虑，并使用降噪耳机配合冥想应用来保持平静。她还喜欢坐在机翼附近，因为那里感觉颠簸不那么明显。

zh.description: 用户为家人预订了东京迪士尼乐园的门票。
zh.content: 用户购买了东京迪士尼乐园和迪士尼海洋的两日门票，用于十一月的家庭旅行。她优先考虑了女儿，并计划使用迪士尼应用程序要求无麸质餐食。

zh.description: 在葡萄牙境内旅行时，用户更喜欢坐火车而不是飞机。
zh.content: 对于葡萄牙境内的目的地，用户尽可能选择火车，因为火车更舒适，对环境的影响也更小。她在葡萄牙火车公司网站上订票。

zh.description: 用户为日本之行购买了全面的旅行保险。
zh.content: 用户购买了一份全面的旅行保险，涵盖医疗费用、行程取消和行李丢失，用于十一月的日本之行。她确保保险覆盖既有疾病，如乳糜泻。

zh.description: 在推荐旅行期间的餐厅时，助手应包含无麸质餐食的供应信息。
zh.content: 当用户在一个新的城市或国家要求餐厅推荐时，助手必须只推荐那些有明确无麸质选项的地方，或者提醒用户需要提前打电话询问交叉污染问题。

zh.description: 用户在2024年参加了马德里的一场金融科技会议。
zh.content: 2024年11月，用户前往马德里参加一场金融科技会议，她参加了关于移动银行用户体验的研讨会。她住在阿托查车站附近的一家酒店，并参观了普拉多博物馆。

zh.description: 和女儿一起旅行时，用户更喜欢带小厨房的酒店或出租房。
zh.content: 由于女儿挑食以及她自己需要无麸质饮食，用户会寻找带小厨房的住宿。这样当餐馆选择有限时，她可以准备简单的饭菜和零食。

zh.description: 她喜欢在浴室翻新中使用哑光黑色的卫浴装置。
zh.content: 用户已决定在浴室翻新中使用哑光黑色的水龙头和淋浴喷头，因为她喜欢现代风格，并认为它比镀铬更能隐藏水渍。她还在考虑搭配同色的毛巾杆和橱柜五金件。

zh.description: 厨房翻新预算是25,000欧元，并带有10%的应急预备金。
zh.content: 用户为厨房翻新设定了25,000欧元的总预算，包括电器和人工。她另外准备了10%的应急预备金，即2,500欧元，用于处理管道或电气工程等意外问题。

zh.description: 她有一个独立的高收益储蓄账户，用于房屋翻新资金。
zh.content: 用户将她的翻新储蓄存放在一个独立的高收益储蓄账户中，年收益率为3.5%。她每月自动向该账户转入500欧元，以避免动用应急基金。

zh.description: 她偏好按年订阅来省钱。
zh.content: 她在大多数订阅上选择年付，只要折扣至少15%，因为她不喜欢每月的小额扣款，并且喜欢每年审查一次订阅。她目前的VPN和云存储都是按年付费。

zh.description: 讨论预算时，总是用欧元列出各项费用并包含总额。
zh.content: 用户希望任何与预算相关的信息，比如装修费用、订阅开支或购买比较，都用欧元逐项列出，并在最后给出明确的总额。她更喜欢用表格或要点列表来清晰呈现。

zh.description: 厨房装修计划于9月1日开始，预计需要6周。
zh.content: 用户的厨房装修承包商已安排在9月1日开始拆除，整个项目预计持续6周。在此期间，用户需要在客厅搭建一个临时厨房。

zh.description: 她更喜欢购买翻新电子产品，以减少电子垃圾并省钱。
zh.content: 用户经常购买认证翻新的电子产品，比如她上一台MacBook和一台扫地机器人，因为它们带有保修，而且比新品便宜20-30%。她会先查看Apple翻新商店和Back Market。

zh.description: 她于7月15日与理财顾问会面，审查她的投资组合。
zh.content: 用户安排在7月15日下午3点与她的理财顾问若昂会面，以重新平衡她的投资组合，并讨论她员工股票期权的节税策略。她想增加ETF配置。

zh.description: 她使用50/30/20预算规则，但为装修储蓄做了调整。
zh.content: 用户遵循改良版的50/30/20预算：50%用于需求，20%用于想要，30%用于储蓄，因为她正在积极为装修和日本之旅存钱。她每月使用电子表格审查各项分类。

zh.description: 她正在为厨房和浴室选择耐用且易于清洁的地板。
zh.content: 用户正在考虑厨房使用豪华乙烯基地砖（LVT），浴室使用瓷砖，优先考虑耐用性和易于清洁，因为家里有小孩和狗。她向两家供应商索取了样品。

zh.description: 总是提醒她在购买超过50欧元的商品前检查促销码或折扣。
zh.content: 用户希望助手提醒她在完成任何超过50欧元的在线购买前，寻找促销码、返现优惠或季节性促销。她讨厌为东西支付全价。

zh.description: 她更喜欢使用提供旅行奖励的信用卡支付大额购物。
zh.content: 用户对所有超过100欧元的消费使用旅行奖励信用卡，以累积飞往日本的机票积分。她每月全额还款以避免利息。

zh.description: 她正在为浴室装修获取三份报价，并协商人工费用。
zh.content: 用户已收到三家承包商对浴室装修的报价，价格从8000到12000欧元不等。她计划协商人工部分，并自己采购材料，以节省15%。

zh.description: 在推荐承包商或供应商时，只包括那些有经过验证的评价和保险的。
zh.content: 用户希望任何关于装修承包商、电工或水管工的推荐只来自经过审核的来源，具有经过验证的在线评价和责任保险证明。她不会考虑无执照的工人。

zh.description: 她在电子表格中跟踪每一笔开支，并每周进行分类。
zh.content: 用户维护一个详细的Google Sheets预算表，记录每一笔购买，从咖啡到装修材料，并每周日晚上审查。她使用条件格式来标记任何类别的超支。

zh.description: 她正在为在阿尔加维买度假屋存首付。
zh.content: 用户单独有一个储蓄目标，为阿尔加维的小度假屋攒5万欧元首付，每月存300欧元。这是个10年的目标。

zh.description: 永远不要在没提醒她咨询理财顾问的情况下建议投资。
zh.content: 她希望助手不要给具体的投资建议；当她问股票、ETF或加密币的时候，助手应该给一般信息，并提醒她在动手前先跟她的顾问若昂确认一下。

zh.description: 她更喜欢从本地小店而不是大卖场买建材。
zh.content: 她经常在里斯本的小五金店买瓷砖、木料和配件，因为她觉得这些店给的 advice 更好，还能支持本地生意，就算价格贵个5-10%也行。

zh.description: 她8月5号约了去银行签装修贷款的文件。
zh.content: 她贷了1万欧的装修贷款，年利率4.2%，来补上存款不够的那部分装修钱。她8月5号上午10点在Millennium BCP有个约，去签那些文件。

zh.description: 用Anki卡片学习日语汉字。
zh.content: 她每天早上花15分钟用自己做的Anki卡组复习JLPT N4的汉字。比起其他记忆软件，她更喜欢Anki，因为能离线同步，插件也多。

zh.description: 用带日语字幕的日剧练习听力。
zh.content: 她在Netflix上看带日语字幕的日剧，锻炼听自然口语。她现在看的是《初恋》。

zh.description: 每周四有日语家教。
zh.content: 她每周四晚上7点跟她的日语私教通过Zoom上课。老师主要教JLPT N4语法和练口语。

zh.description: 写日语时希望得到礼貌的纠正。
zh.content: 如果她用日语写，助手要温柔地纠正语法或词汇错误，并用葡萄牙语解释正确说法。她喜欢那种鼓励式的纠正，不喜欢被批评。

zh.description: 打算N4之后考JLPT N3。
zh.content: 她的长期目标是明年12月前过N3。她打算继续跟同一个老师，N4考完后把汉字学习加到每天30分钟。

zh.description: 学日语喜欢用《Genki》教材。
zh.content: 她用《Genki II》的课本和练习册练语法和阅读。她喜欢里面解释得很清楚，觉得习题对巩固句型挺有用的。

zh.description: 正在读村上春树的《1Q84》。
zh.content: 她现在读的是村上春树的《1Q84》葡语版。已经读了一半，挺喜欢那种双线叙事的。

zh.description: 喜欢魔幻现实主义作家，如加西亚·马尔克斯和若热·亚马多。
zh.content: 她特别喜欢魔幻现实主义，最爱的作家有加西亚·马尔克斯和若热·亚马多。她喜欢他们把现实和奇幻混在一起的感觉。

zh.description: 里斯本每月读书会的成员。
zh.content: 用户参加了一个里斯本的读书会，每月第一个星期三在当地一家咖啡馆聚会。小组选择文学小说，通常在葡萄牙语和英语书籍之间交替。

zh.description: 使用Goodreads跟踪阅读，年度目标是24本书。
zh.content: 用户在Goodreads上追踪她的阅读情况，并设定了每年24本书的目标。她每周更新进度，并为每本读完的书写简短评论。

zh.content: 用户喜欢文学小说的纸质书，因为喜欢触感体验，但在类型小说和旅行阅读时使用Kindle以节省空间和重量。

zh.description: 在书籍推荐中需要动物死亡触发警告。
zh.content: 当推荐书籍时，助手应该标记任何涉及动物死亡或虐待的内容。用户觉得这类场景令人痛苦，想要避免。

zh.description: 弹原声吉他，正在学习波萨诺瓦。
zh.content: 用户弹原声吉他，目前正在学习波萨诺瓦和弦进行。她每个工作日晚间在女儿上床后练习20分钟。

zh.description: 收集黑胶唱片，特别是波萨诺瓦和城市流行乐。
zh.content: 用户收集黑胶唱片，专注于波萨诺瓦和日本城市流行乐。她在客厅有一个专门的小架子，喜欢周末逛唱片店。

zh.content: 用户喜欢在任天堂Switch上玩温馨的独立游戏，目前正在玩《星露谷物语》。她觉得工作后玩这个很放松，经常在睡前玩30分钟。

zh.description: 周日早上跟着YouTube视频做瑜伽。
zh.content: 用户每个周日早上跟着YouTube上的30分钟初学者瑜伽练习。她在翻新过的客厅里用瑜伽垫，专注于拉伸以帮助跑步恢复。

zh.description: 在长时间会议期间编织。
zh.content: 用户在冗长或被动的会议期间编织简单的围巾和洗碗布以帮助集中注意力。她在办公桌旁放一个小项目袋，选择不需要盯着看的图案。

zh.content: 用户喜欢街头摄影，周末散步时带着富士X100V。她喜欢在里斯本的阿尔法玛和格拉萨街区捕捉真实瞬间。

zh.description: 参加每月一次的桌游小组。
zh.content: 用户是一个每月桌游小组的成员，该小组每月第二个星期六在朋友家聚会。小组轮流选择游戏，通常偏好策略和合作类游戏。

zh.description: 喜欢数独和填字游戏等益智游戏。
zh.content: 用户喜欢数独和填字游戏等逻辑益智游戏。她在通勤时用手机解题，偶尔为海滩旅行购买益智书。

zh.description: 工作时听lo-fi嘻哈。
zh.content: 用户在做UI设计工作时会在Spotify上听lo-fi嘻哈播放列表。她觉得稳定的节拍能帮助她进入深度专注状态，而不会被歌词分心。

zh.description: 最喜欢的乐队是Radiohead，看过两次现场。
zh.content: 用户最喜欢的乐队是Radiohead，她看过两次现场：一次在里斯本，一次在巴塞罗那。她的办公室里挂着一张巴塞罗那演唱会的装裱海报。

zh.description: 使用Spotify家庭套餐。
zh.content: 用户订阅了Spotify的家庭套餐，涵盖她的账户、Miguel的账户，以及给Beatriz的单独资料。她为半程马拉松训练创建了高BPM的跑步播放列表。

zh.description: 去年在里斯本参加了Cornelius的演唱会。
zh.content: 用户去年在里斯本的Aula Magna参加了日本艺术家Cornelius的演唱会。她通过城市流行音乐的推荐发现了他，并且很喜欢现场的视觉表演。

zh.content: 用户每天早上喝咖啡时玩Wordle，并通过WhatsApp与一位密友分享她的结果网格。她同时使用英语和葡萄牙语版本以保持词汇量敏锐。

zh.description: 喜欢像《瘟疫危机》这样的合作桌游。
zh.content: 用户更喜欢合作桌游而非竞技类，其中《瘟疫危机》是她的最爱。她喜欢团队合作的元素，并拥有原版游戏以及《一触即发》扩展包。

zh.content: 用户尝试用Duolingo学日语，但发现连击机制和排行榜太让人分心。她转而使用Anki和Bunpro的组合来进行语法练习。

zh.description: 和女儿在Switch上玩《马里奥赛车》。
zh.content: 用户在下雨的周末会和女儿Beatriz在任天堂Switch上玩《马里奥赛车8豪华版》。她们通常选择同一个角色耀西，并在简单赛道上比赛。

zh.description: 周六早上去农贸市场买无麸质面包。
zh.content: 每周六早上，用户都会去Campo de Ourique的当地农贸市场，从一家经过认证的面包摊位购买无麸质面包。她还会顺便买些时令蔬菜，有时也买花。

zh.content: 用户每周日晚上花30分钟用子弹笔记回顾过去一周并规划下一周。她为工作、家庭和个人项目设定三个主要目标。

zh.content: 用户每周日下午为工作周准备无麸质午餐。她煮大量的藜麦、烤蔬菜和烤鸡，并将它们存放在贴有标签的容器中。

zh.content: 用户和她丈夫米格尔每周六晚上都会在里斯本的不同无麸质餐厅度过固定的约会之夜。他们会在几家值得信赖、保证无交叉污染的地方轮换。

zh.description: 固定规则：评估无麸质餐厅选项时要查看菜单和交叉污染说明。
zh.content: 向用户推荐餐厅时，助手必须查看在线菜单和过敏原声明，注意是否有共用炸锅或交叉污染风险，并标记餐厅是否为纯无麸质。如果不确定，助手应如实说明而不是猜测。

zh.description: 固定规则：对于工作相关的回复，使用要点列表，最多150字。
zh.content: 除非用户要求更多细节，否则所有工作相关的回答都要简洁、以要点列表形式组织，并且不超过150字。这适用于电子邮件、设计反馈和项目规划。

zh.description: 用户更喜欢使用 Figma 的自动布局来快速制作线框图。
zh.content: 在做 UI 设计工作时，用户大量使用 Figma 的自动布局和交互组件，她喜欢用快捷键来快速做原型。她很讨厌那些会破坏自动布局的插件。

zh.description: 用户有六年高级 Figma 经验，并指导初级设计师。
zh.content: 用户专业使用 Figma 已有六年，被团队视为设计系统方面的专家。她每隔一周的周五指导两名初级设计师学习原型制作的最佳实践。

zh.description: 用户偏好的无麸质面包品牌。

zh.content: 用户正在组织贝阿特丽斯6岁的生日派对，时间是2026年4月19日下午3点到5点，地点在埃斯特雷拉花园（Jardim da Estrela）。她已经预约了脸部彩绘师，并从一家专门的烘焙店订购了无麸质蛋糕。

zh.content: 用户计划于2026年8月3日去卡斯凯什（Cascais）看望父母，庆祝父亲的生日。她会带一个自制的无麸质 'bolo de bolacha'（饼干蛋糕），因为她父亲也是乳糜泻患者。

zh.description: 用户在2025年6月21日有JLPT N4模拟考试。
zh.content: 用户报名了2025年6月21日下午2点在里斯本一所语言学校举行的JLPT N4模拟考试。她想模拟考试环境，然后复习她最薄弱的语法点。

zh.content: 用户将于2025年5月30日上午10点与面包店老板会面，审查新的菜单页面并讨论无麸质标签问题。她将展示两个Figma模型和一份进度账单。

zh.content: 装修承包商将于2025年9月1日开始厨房拆除。用户将在客厅设置一个临时微波炉和电热水壶，并预计厨房将停用四周。

zh.description: 用户在2025年5月24日有一次集体训练跑。
zh.content: 用户加入了一个跑步俱乐部，于2025年5月24日上午7点在蒙桑托森林公园进行10公里训练跑。她计划带上吸入器，并以对话配速跑步。

zh.content: 全家的日本之旅包括2026年11月12日至15日在京都的酒店住宿，他们计划参观伏见稻荷和岚山。用户需要提前预订无麸质怀石料理晚餐。

zh.content: 用户与经理的年度绩效评估于2025年10月20日上午11点进行。她准备了一份设计作品集和一份薪资谈判要点清单。

zh.content: 用户在Google Sheets预算中跟踪所有装修费用，包括人工、材料和许可证等类别。她每周日晚上更新，并将实际费用与初步估算进行比较。
